thread:
tess: Heads-up — woke up to an increase in mTLS rejects from multi-region edges after the keystore RBAC roll last night. Proxy 502s and backend shows 'handshake denied'. Anyone else?

omar: I saw alerts for APAC and EU. Short window but spike is clear. Any logs?

lina: Pasted a couple of snippets from keystore and proxy: 
```
2026-06-05T22:11:12Z keystore-0 INFO rbac-check: principal=svc-proxy.apac check=decrypt result=DENY reason=rolebinding-missing
2026-06-05T22:11:12Z proxy-1 WARN tls: handshake failed client=svc-web.apac, err=handshake_denied stage=unwrap-key
```

ops-oncall: If KEYSERVICE returns DENY before hitting KMS, there will be no KMS audit entry. Can we confirm whether keystore is performing an early-authorize pre-check?

tess: yes, recent change added an early-authorize step to reduce KMS QPS. It returns 403-like deny if RoleBinding evaluation fails. That explains empty KMS audit.

omar: That's reasonable for cost but bad for observability. We need at minimum an audit stub emitted into our logshipper when early-deny happens so incidents have a trace.

lina: Agreed. Also noticed the RoleBinding template generator dropped explicit SA subjects for some clusters (region var was empty for apac-staging). That's why group-based binding expansion failed.

ops-oncall: I can hotfix the rolebinding in staging/apac-prod. But before changes: collect artifacts — kube-audit event for the RBAC apply, keystore logs (rbac-check lines), proxy envoy logs with peer_cert_sha256 and sni, and the rendered manifest that pipeline applied.

keystore-bot: Created correlation id trace=audit-stub-20260605-2212. Use this id to search keystore logs and logshipper.

ops-oncall: Rolling a targeted patch to re-add SA subjects in apac-prod: 
```
kubectl --context=apac-prod -n infra apply -f /manifests/keystore/rolebinding-add-sas.yaml
kubectl rollout restart deploy/keystore -n infra
```

~5m later~

lina: Patch applied; handshake reject rate in APAC down from ~3.4% to 0.2%. EU still shows small blips — looks like same template bug there.

omar: Good recovery. Immediate follow-ups: 1) fix template renderer so namespace and SA are always fully-qualified, 2) make keystore emit a structured 'early-deny' audit event with fields: principal, reason, sni, peer_cert_sha256, trace_id, and whether KMS call was attempted, 3) add a canary decrypt step to the RBAC pipeline that runs inside-cluster as the target SA post-apply.

ops-oncall: Also recommend adding an alert: if mtls_handshake_denied_rate{region!=""} > 0.5% for 3m -> page. Runbook to include `kubectl get rolebinding -n infra keystore-* -o yaml` and grepping keystore logs for `rbac-check`.

lina: On the audit side, PRIYA (cc @pri) earlier proposed increasing KMS audit retention and ensuring our logshipper includes keystore early-deny stubs. Priya: can you confirm retention and sink changes?

security-bot: @priya not in thread; pinged via DM to confirm. Incident INC-2026-182 created: 'Multi-region mTLS denies after keystore RBAC roll'. Severity: P2.

keystore-bot: Planned change: add config flag `keystore.emit_earlydeny_audit=true` and log an `audit_stub_id` with metadata. This will be shipped behind a feature flag.

omar: For CI/rollout hardening: add a preflight that after `kubectl apply` runs `kubectl auth can-i decrypt --as=system:serviceaccount:<ns>:svc-proxy -n infra` OR run a short job that executes `keystore-cli canary-decrypt` as that SA. Fail the pipeline if canary decrypt fails.

tess: I'll open a PR with the template fix and the canary job. Lina — can you take telemetry/audit stub changes? Ops-oncall — update runbook with the new preflight and alert thresholds. Omar — please add the Grafana panel and alert rule. Priya — can you confirm KMS audit retention and that logshipper will accept early-deny stubs?

keystore-bot: Reminder: attach trace/audit-stub ids and kube-audit event IDs to the incident ticket and PR for postmortem.

ops-oncall: Note for rollback patterns: RBAC splits should be first applied to a single cluster (canary), verify canary decrypt, then roll out. Avoid global group-binding swaps in one go.

tess: Thanks team. We'll run a short blameless postmortem and track follow-ups in the incident board.

lina: one more action — increase visibility on the early-authorize path in our dashboards (expose metric keystore_rbac_early_deny_total{region}), so we can alert before customer impact.

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-182 updated: linked PRs and runbook tasks.

tess: closing loop here. Recovered and follow-ups assigned. Thanks all :thumbsup:
